The retrieved account of UBS describes $102 billion of additional financing for expansion during 2027–2030, a different period and measure. The claimed customer concentration also remains unverified. These differences cannot be silently converted into matching evidence.
limitations: Investor motives come from independent reporting rather than a controlled causal study.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The chill in AI data center debt markets comes from people realising that CoreWeave is a time bomb of expensive debt: its debt is selling off as they see that delivering its supposed $104 billion backlog (at least 50% OpenAI and Anthropic) will need about $102 billion in debt over the next three years, per UBS.

statement.excerpt: Said chill comes from the world finally waking up to what I said in March 2025 — that CoreWeave is a time bomb of expensive debt that’s now selling off as people realize that making any of its supposed $104 billion in backlog (at least 50% of which is OpenAI and Anthropic) will require, per UBS, about $102 billion in debt in the next three years.

from_speaker: at least 50% of which is OpenAI and Anthropic
per UBS, about $102 billion in debt
our_interpretation: Assess whether recognition of CoreWeave’s financing exposure materially contributed to its debt selloff and the broader cooling of AI infrastructure credit.
Treat 'time bomb' as a description of financing vulnerability, not a separate prediction of bankruptcy.
The three-year figure is an attribution to an existing UBS estimate. This assessment does not wait three years to measure actual borrowing.
Use October 13–20, 2026 for the current market episode, following the surrounding reference to the last week. Earlier financial disclosures are contextual inputs.
The structured money scope describes the claimed additional debt requirement. The backlog and customer concentration are separate supporting assertions.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous market evidence links the selloff materially to this financing exposure, and independent records verify the backlog, customer concentration, and UBS estimate on the stated debt basis and three-year horizon.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records materially refute the financing assertions, or persuasive contemporaneous evidence shows that recognition of this exposure did not materially contribute to the selloff.
